subject: Physics
q: A leak-proof cylindrical body of length 1 m and negligible thermal expansion floats vertically in water. Its height above the surface is 20 cm at 0°C and 21 cm at 4°C. Approximately what is the ratio of the density of water at 4°C to that at 0°C?
hint: Equate the body's unchanged weight to the buoyant force at each temperature.
solution: The submerged lengths are 80 cm at 0°C and 79 cm at 4°C. With cross-sectional area A, flotation gives ρ₀A(80)g = ρ₄A(79)g. Hence ρ₄/ρ₀ = 80/79 ≈ 1.0127, which is closest to 1.01.
